turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Rachel Lim. This is Daniel Lee. We have our telephone review arranged for today. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, or would you prefer a little time to settle in before we start?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello, Daniel. I'm comfortable here, thank you. I've just come in from the garden, so this is a good time. It's rather pleasant to have a quiet afternoon away from the business.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds like a welcome change of pace. Have you been doing much planting recently, or mostly looking after what's already there?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Mostly looking after what's there. I've been clearing the beds and moving a few pots into the shade. I enjoy having something practical to do that doesn't involve looking at a screen.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: A change from desk work, certainly. Before we begin the review, could you provide your identification number and date of birth?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My NRIC number is S three one three five zero zero nine E. My date of birth is the thirtieth of April nineteen eighty-seven.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. We can turn to the review now.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The holding I want to transact in is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell that holding.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your objective is to reduce your exposure to Asian equities and free up funds for anticipated personal spending. That is the objective I am working towards in this review. I recommend reducing your holding in Meridian Asia Equity Fund because that lowers your exposure to Asian equity-market fluctuations and releases funds for your anticipated spending.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'd like you to cover the relevant information before we get to the final instruction. I prefer to keep the discussion straightforward.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Meridian Asia Equity Fund can fall in value if Asian stock markets decline during regional economic weakness or political uncertainty. Its value may also change before your sale is executed, so the proceeds are not fixed when you give the instruction. Do you understand how those regional market risks affect the fund and that its value can change before your sale is executed?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Regional market falls can reduce the fund's value, and the proceeds can change before the sale is executed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee for this sale is 0.25%. You may lose some or all of the capital you invested in the fund. Selling at a value below what you invested would crystallise that loss. Are you willing to accept an investment loss, including crystallising a loss through this sale, to reduce your market exposure?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept an investment loss on this sale to reduce my exposure. Before we finish the review, could we also settle how to arrange future calls? It's easier if I can put them in my diary rather than take an unexpected call at work.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. We can arrange routine reviews in advance and send an appointment invitation. Would you prefer that we contact you by email to arrange a suitable time, rather than telephone you to schedule it?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Email would be better. I can check my diary properly that way. If something changes at the business, I'll reply to rearrange rather than try to fit a review between meetings.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that scheduling preference. That covers the arrangements for future reviews; we can return to today's instruction.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please use Singapore dollars as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am instructing is 100,000. The quantity I am instructing is 1,000 units. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please explicitly confirm your final instruction to sell 1,000 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund, with a transaction amount of 100,000 in Singapore dollars, using a market order.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please execute it as stated.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. That concludes our discussion today. If you need to change a review appointment, you can contact me through the usual bank channel. Thank you for making time for the call.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Daniel. The arranged call worked well for me. Enjoy the rest of your afternoon. Goodbye.
